packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry: update core (v1.x) and the 0.x log modules together in ONE PR and never automerge - a core bump without the log modules (or vice-versa) breaks the build. A bump here also needs the third_party forks re-vendored by hand; see third_party/README.md.
